correctness.rationale: The regular-polygon formulas are normalized into x=D/P and y=A/(PD). The even family has an exact one-parameter graph whose second derivative with respect to x is strictly positive; the derivative sign is proved from h''(theta)=4 theta sin(2 theta)>=0 and zero initial data. Every odd n-gon has the same x as the even 2n-gon but strictly smaller y. Hence all finite regular polygons except the square lie strictly below the square--disk chord, and linear optimization gives the claimed two-branch envelope and exact crossover. The packaged symbolic checker independently verifies all identities.
